# Master Plan · Winter Semester 2026/27

*Version 4 · Mon 19 Oct 2026 · **fresh start on Tue 20 Oct** (student's request: reset everything). Courses: **Big Data,
Inference, Data Science in Context**, plus **German** on the side and **gym** 4 mornings a week. NLP and Industrial Data
Science 1 were dropped. Each course's detailed plan is in its own folder (`semester-plan.md`). **One week numbering for
everything: W1 = week of Mon 19 Oct 2026**; H1/H2 = the two Christmas weeks. Online overview with a day view for any
date: https://claude.ai/artifact/HWvuvfoN3XtLec2nHMRTa5*

---

## 0. The semester in one minute

- **3 courses, 17 CP:** Big Data 9 · Inference 5 · Data Science in Context 3. **Plus German** (A2 → B1, no credits).
- **Exams:** Big Data **Wed 10 Feb 2027, 17:30** (written, 120 min; 2nd date Tue 16 Mar) · Inference **about
  mid-March** (date not out yet) · Data Science in Context: multiple choice (date not out yet) · German: B1 exam May–July.
- **Every week: about 35 hours of study + gym on Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat mornings (~3 h each, from home). Sunday is free.**
- **Big Data is the main course** (~17 h/week, including the maths and Python it needs).
- **The method:** learn every lecture **on the same day**, test yourself **every week**, fix each mistake until it is
  right twice, never let a gap grow.
- **Everything starts from the beginning:** Inference at session 1A, Big Data at lectures 1–2 (slides on Moodle) and
  foundations F01–F02, Python bootcamp from session 1, German with a level check.

## 7. How you study

- **Test yourself instead of re-reading** (retrieval practice and spacing have the strongest evidence). Every week ends
  with a closed-book quiz; old mistakes come back until right twice.
- **Same-day review** beats a long weekend session. **Write by hand** for theory; **type the code yourself** (no AI).
- **One Claude session per study block** in that course's repo: "Let's continue" (or the session name in §5), end with
  "Wrap up". Ask any repo "What's my plan today?".
- **After every Big Data lecture**, add the slides to `BigData/materials/` and push (GitHub "Add files via upload" works on the tablet).

---

## 8. Plan reviews, red flags, and the minimum week

**Plan reviews** (Monday planning block): W2 (26 Oct) · W5 (16 Nov) · W8 (7 Dec) · W10 (4 Jan) · W13 (25 Jan, with the
exam decision) · W16 (15 Feb).

| Signal | What happens |
|---|---|
| A weekly test < 60% | That course's next block becomes a repair session |
| Blocks missed | They go to the next FLEX; if FLEX is full, use the course's cut list |
| Less than 25 study hours two weeks in a row | Plan review: what is blocking? |
| Ill, overloaded, or sleeping < 7 h most nights | **Minimum week**: Big Data lectures, tutorial and same-day reviews, one sheet, Inference A and D, German Tuesday block, 3 gym mornings |
